title: Quiet Campus school Escape
content: I had a school area dream the other night. It appears to be a section of Mallworld because there is that same sense of specific vividness , surprising continuity between dreams, and concreteness to the scenes that other dreams don't have. There was the continuity from a previous dream, of the campus having some sort of dress code policy. Kids protested it, and unfortunately the mean principle made a stricter policy as a result. In this dream, all the kids on campus had some sort of school uniform and apparently had to be very quiet now too. A bratty kid approached me and tried to place a few water balloons filled with paint under my shoe. A avoided that and ran away. Somehow, running got me somewhat lucid. The area seemed as if it had a mind of its own and tried various things to block me from leaving the scene. First it tried a classic, thick spiderweb in the doorway. I was lucid enough to not fall for it and pushed through after looking back and seeing some jocks running my way. The next room looked nothing like the campus area, more like an abandoned wild west theme park room. The area then tried to block my way with a fake wall. Somehow I knew it was a fake wall and kept going forward. Next I made it outside the building or someplace and the creepiest thing occured: Seemingly all the people in the campus area and another building outside yelled really loud in unison "Don't let him leave!". There were knights in armor of all things outside yelling this too.
